SEP-7 tx URI decoded for signing with no timebounds or expiry check
Fee-increase cap (maxFee) is dropped on the retry, so fee escalation is unbounded after the first retry

Client-domain signer returns an unverified transaction that the client then signs
Sep6 deposit rethrows raw Axios error carrying the Bearer token in config.headers
extractAxiosErrorData serializes the raw Node request object on no-response errors
SEP-6 bearer token is sent to an unvalidated transferServer URL that may be plain http
SEP-24 POST and GET send the SEP-10 bearer token to an unvalidated stellar.toml transfer server URL
SEP-24 getTransactionBy and getTransactionsForAsset send the SEP-10 bearer token to an unvalidated stellar.toml transfer server URL
SEP-38 sends the SEP-10 bearer token to an unvalidated stellar.toml quote server URL
Watcher transaction helpers send the SEP-10 bearer token to any endpoint string they are given
parseToml passes stellar.toml endpoint URLs through with no scheme or host validation
Withdrawal payment destination and amount come from the anchor response with no check
isValidSep7Uri throws a raw TypeError on a malformed URI instead of returning a result
Account-authority builders (accountMerge, signer, threshold, master-key lock) have no enforced control
getQuote interpolates quoteId raw into the URL path while sending the bearer token
Anchor constructor accepts allowHttp on any network, bypassing the testnet-only guard in Wallet.anchor
SponsoringBuilder.createAccount has no bound or minimum on the sponsor-funded starting balance
Binary SEP-12 upload sends a JSON body under a multipart/form-data header
SEP-9 info map can overwrite the explicit id, type and memo in update()
SEP-9 info key "type" overrides the explicit type argument in add()
fundTestnetAccount sends the address to friendbot on any configured network and skips the documented testnet-only check

SEP-6 info() interpolates lang into the query string without encoding

SEP-24 info() interpolates lang into the query string without encoding
Recovery server signatures are attached without verification against the transaction
SEP-7 pubkey param is parsed but never enforced when choosing the signing key
Request-signature payload strip fails when signature is the first query parameter or is not percent-encoded, so valid signed URIs are rejected
SEP-7 pay URI asset_code is accepted and exposed without asset_issuer
SEP-38 methods build request URLs from a missing ANCHOR_QUOTE_SERVER without checking it
sep7ReplacementsFromString silently drops every ';' segment after the second

camelToSnakeCaseObject silently drops one of two keys that map to the same snake_case name
No-response branch serializes a live Node request object, which can throw and mask the original network failure
parseToml crashes when PRINCIPALS, CURRENCIES or VALIDATORS is not an array
getUrlDomain returns host with port, so the derived homeDomain is not a bare domain
parseToml throws when a stellar.toml has no DOCUMENTATION table
Anchor-issued SEP-10 JWT is accepted after decode only, with no signature verification
Sep12.delete deletes any account's KYC record with the caller's token
SEP-10 challenge URL is built from unencoded memo and client-domain values, allowing query-parameter injection
Caller-chosen homeDomain keeps host:port and is fetched as an outbound stellar.toml request
Retry after a 504 reports an already-applied submission as a failure
Withdrawal and SEP-24 asset checks match on code without the anchor's issuer
SEP-7 tx URI chooses the network passphrase for the transaction it returns, defaulting to PUBLIC
